speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition better, could you tell me if the double vision or weakness fluctuates throughout the day, such as getting worse in the evening or after activity?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of worsening weakness after activity and improvement with rest is highly suggestive of a neuromuscular junction disorder. I will now order specific tests to confirm this suspicion. REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibodies REQUEST TEST: Repetitive_Nerve_Stimulation
